questions.de: Welcher britische Forscher umrundete als Erster die Antarktis?
questions.en: Which British explorer was the first to circumnavigate Antarctica?

timeline.labelEn: James Cook's second voyage, which circled the far Southern Ocean around Antarctica
timeline.labelDe: James Cooks zweite Reise, die das Südpolarmeer rund um die Antarktis umrundete

questions.notes: Cook circled the continent at high southern latitudes on his second voyage (1772–1775) and crossed the Antarctic Circle three times, but never sighted the Antarctic mainland.

questions.cardDe: Welche heute weltweit bekannte Automarke benannte August Horch nach sich selbst?
questions.de: Welche heute weltweit bekannte Automarke benannte August Horch nach sich selbst?
questions.en: Which car brand, known worldwide today, did August Horch name after himself?

timeline.labelEn: August Horch founds a new car company in Zwickau, whose cars were sold as Audi
timeline.labelDe: August Horch gründet in Zwickau ein neues Automobilwerk, dessen Wagen als Audi verkauft wurden

questions.notes: Horch was barred from using his own surname for his new company, so 'Audi' is the Latin translation of 'Horch!' (listen!). His first firm, Horch, also bore his name but is not the brand known worldwide today.
